input.overview: Smart Set keeps its center wheel moving throughout the ball. The side eject pockets and lower Wheel Value rollovers stop it. A stop on 20 awards an extra ball on the factory setup, while a number-to-color match lights 10 Times Value so tens score hundreds. Completing A and B opens the right gate and lights the jet bumpers for increased value.
input.simpleOverview: Complete A and B at the top to open the right gate and light the four jet bumpers for higher value. Then use a side eject pocket or a lower Wheel Value rollover to stop the moving wheel. A number that matches the lit color turns on 10 Times Value; use the upper bumpers and rollovers while that lamp is on. Treat the wheel's 20 extra-ball result as a bonus only when the installed setup awards it.
input.summary: Light A and B for the gate and stronger jets, then stop the wheel through controlled eject-pocket or lower-rollover feeds. When a number matches the lit color, keep the ball in the upper scoring area while 10 Times Value is active.

quickInfo.name: Wheel stops
quickInfo.summary: Either side eject pocket or lower Wheel Value rollover stops the moving wheel.

quickInfo.name: 10 Times Value
quickInfo.summary: A stopped number matching the lit color changes tens scoring to hundreds.

quickInfo.name: A and B
quickInfo.summary: Completing both letters opens the right gate and lights the jet bumpers for increased value.

quickInfo.name: Wheel 20
quickInfo.summary: Awards an extra ball on the factory setup; tournament or novelty settings may convert or disable it.

steps.text: Complete the top A and B switches without forcing a dangerous upper-lane feed.
After A and B are lit, use the opened right gate and increased-value jet bumpers to keep the ball scoring up top.
Use a controlled side eject pocket or lower Wheel Value rollover to stop the moving wheel.
If the stopped number matches the lit color, keep the ball in the upper bumpers and rollovers while 10 Times Value is on.
Take the wheel's 20 result as a bonus only when the installed setup makes the extra-ball or conversion award useful.

buildsToward.title: An A-B setup followed by 10 Times Value

steps.text: Light A and B to open the right gate and raise the jet-bumper value.
Stop the wheel through a side eject pocket or lower Wheel Value rollover.
When the stopped number matches the lit color, play the safer upper scoring area while 10 Times Value is active.

cautions.issue: The wheel advances quickly, so a specific number or color match is not a reliable aimed outcome.
cautions.response: Choose the safest available wheel-stop feed and treat 10 Times Value or 20 as the result, not as a precision shot.

cautions.issue: The factory 20 result is an extra ball, but operator and tournament settings can change or disable awards.
cautions.response: Check the installed award before sacrificing control to another wheel stop.

machineSetup: Confirm Williams Smart Set model 363, OPDB exact variant G5YQK-MvBzn. Do not transfer rules from similarly named games.
Check three- or five-ball play, the Wheel 20 award, replay and high-score conversions, liberal or conservative post positions, and whether extra balls are disabled for tournament play.

Test the moving wheel, both side eject pockets, both lower Wheel Value rollovers, the four color lamps, 10 Times Value, A and B, the right gate, all four jet bumpers, flippers, posts, and tilt response.

playfieldReferences.label: Top A and B switches
playfieldReferences.description: The two upper letter switches that open the right gate and light the jet bumpers for increased value when completed.

playfieldReferences.label: Left and right eject pockets
playfieldReferences.description: The side pockets that stop the moving wheel and score its selected value.

playfieldReferences.label: Lower Wheel Value rollovers
playfieldReferences.description: The two lower rollovers that stop the moving wheel.

playfieldReferences.label: 10 Times Value lamp
playfieldReferences.description: The center feature lit when the stopped wheel number matches the active color.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-right return gate
playfieldReferences.description: The gate opened by completing A and B.
